t.zh: 质检台只能逐位置比较，无法利用周围读数区分细碎干扰和较大结构。这章要造邻域处理器，再把它装成扫描器。先从三个位置开始：取样位置与贡献权重分开，所有数值由电路计算。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The station compares individual locations but cannot use surrounding readings to separate fine nuisance from broader structure. Build a neighbourhood processor and then a scanner. Start with three positions: sample locations and contributions are separate; the circuit does the arithmetic. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 同一套位置权重可以沿行或列使用；读取方向决定哪些邻居参与，权重的位置与符号决定各自的贡献。每次处理仍然只覆盖一条线。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
after.en: One positional weighting rule can act along rows or columns. Direction selects the neighbours; weight position and sign determine their contributions. Each pass still covers one line. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 用给定的位置权重组合左、中、右三个读数。取样方向 d=(1,0)，前侧读 -d，后侧读 d。输出与输入同尺寸，图外取 0；权重不必总为正，也不自动归一化。
brief.en: Combine left, centre and right readings with the supplied positional weights. The direction is d=(1,0): read the first at -d and the last at d. Preserve image size, read zero outside, and do not automatically normalise or discard negative weights.

after.zh: 权重的位置、符号与总和分别影响方向、响应与增益。负权重和非单位增益也有用途。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Weight positions, signs and sum affect direction, response and gain. Negative weights and non-unit gain can be useful. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 位置权重跟随读取的位置；交换两侧会反转非对称规则。恒定图还会显示权重和造成的增益。
naiveWhy.en: Weights belong to positions. Swapping sides reverses an asymmetric rule; constants also expose the gain from the weight sum.

hint.zh: 亮点能显示谁贡献到哪个位置；先把三路分别接到输出观察，再组合。
hint.en: An impulse reveals which sample contributes where. Inspect the branches before combining them.

hint.zh: 常量图检验总增益，非对称权重检验方向；系统计算所有乘积与和。
hint.en: Constants test gain and asymmetric weights test direction; products and sums are automatic.

brief.zh: 用预设三点加权器，将给定 [前, 中, 后] 权重向量沿方向 d 用于读数图。d=(0,1) 对应上、中、下，(1,0) 对应左、中、右；保持尺寸，图外取 0。权重向量整组接入一个口。
brief.en: Use the weighted-line preset with the supplied [first, centre, last] weight vector and direction d. d=(0,1) reads above/centre/below and (1,0) reads left/centre/right. Preserve size and use zero outside. Connect the whole weight vector to one port.

naiveWhy.zh: 交换前后读取方向会反转非对称权重的响应。用不对称权重检查上、下是否交换。
naiveWhy.en: Reversing the read direction reverses the response of asymmetric weights. Use unequal side weights to distinguish above and below.

hint.zh: 先用单个亮点观察响应是在同一行还是同一列展开；再用不对称权重检查上、下是否交换。无需手算数值。
hint.en: Use one impulse to see whether support spreads along its row or column, then asymmetric weights to check above/below order. Numerical calculation is automatic.

t.zh: 横向三格的加权关系已经验证。现在用三点加权器复用这个固定计算：权重按 [前, 中, 后] 排成一个向量，整组接入；改变方向 d 就能处理一列。预设执行固定计算，不使用之前的电路。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The horizontal three-sample relationship is established. Reuse it with the weighted-line preset: connect the entire [first, centre, last] weight vector, then change direction d to process columns. This preset executes a fixed computation independently of the earlier circuit. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
